name: Tiko Type
subtitle: Type and speak
promotional_text: Type words and hear them spoken. A simple text-to-speech app for children and emergent communicators.
description:
Tiko Type is a simple text-to-speech app. Type a word or a sentence and hear it spoken aloud — giving a voice to children and anyone building literacy and communication skills.

Big, clear text and instant speech make it ideal for emergent communicators and early readers.

- Type and tap to speak
- Large, readable text
- Speak single words or full sentences
- No ads, focused and calm

Part of Tiko, a child-first universe of small, focused AAC tools.
